text:
Priya: dropping the updated catalog mock — focused on a denser compare table + a new "collapsed filters" affordance. want feedback on: 1) collapsed filter behaviour (inline reveal vs flyout), 2) performance badge treatment for low-vision users, 3) pin semantics when comparing multiple versions. figma: https://figma.redwood/catalog-compact :pushpin:

Diego: Love the density. Quick thought: inline reveal (expand within the filter rail) keeps context. Flyout feels like a modal and kills multitasking. If we go inline, show a clear keyboard target to open/close with Enter / Space.

Hannah: Accessibility: perf badges as small colored pills fail contrast in dark themes. Two fixes: add bold numeric text + a subtle outline, and supply an icon (clock/lightning) to convey meaning without color dependence. Also ensure the pills have focus outlines for keyboard nav.

Ravi: Engineering heads-up: if we add outlines we must ensure row heights don't jump. prefer overlays or absolute-positioned badges so layout doesn't shift. Also: storing pin state — prefer keeping it in URL for shareability first, then sync to profile later. URL-only approach avoids backend changes for MVP.

Priya: Good point on URL. My concern: long query strings if multiple pins + many filters. We could compress state (short keys) or use a share token endpoint later. For now, short query params like ?p=mdl1,mdl3&f=tf-2 are ok.

Diego: For collapsed filters microcopy: use "Show 2 filters" not "+2" — clearer for screen readers. Add aria-expanded and aria-controls on the control.

Hannah: Copy tweak for pin tooltip: current "Pin" -> prefer "Pin version to session"? But that sounds ephemeral. Maybe "Pin version (persists in this browser)" for MVP when it's URL/local only. If backend persists later, update tooltip to "Pinned across devices".

Ravi: Implementation plan: Step 1: URL-encoded pins + localStorage fallback. Step 2: user settings API with pinnedVersions array for enterprise sync. We'll document that local pins are cleared on cookie/localStorage clear. I'll make a PR outline.

Priya: Visual affordance — show a tiny "Pinned" label on the model thumbnail and a filled pin icon. Add a small "share" button that copies the current compare URL (including pins/filters).

Diego: Motion idea: when pinned, animate a micro-trajectory from the pin button to the thumbnail label so users see the connection. Keep to 120ms.

Hannah: A11y snippet for pin button: <button aria-pressed="true" aria-label="Pinned version v2.1.4">📌</button>. Also ensure the state change is announced by SR-only text.

Priya: Badge design options: 1) colored pill + icon, 2) monochrome icon + number (text-only) for compact mode, 3) a combined mode. Which should be default? I'm leaning to 1 with an opt-in compact switch in profile.

Ravi: Default to option 1. Compact mode can be toggled via a query param for devs now (?compact=1) and saved later.

Diego: Keyboard UX: when filters are collapsed and you open the inline list, trap focus within that list until Escape — but allow Tab to move between filter chips. Also support multi-select with Shift.

Hannah: Small copy suggestion for the share snackbar: "Compare link copied — includes pinned versions and filters" (and link icon). keeps it explicit.

Priya: Next steps: Diego — prototype inline reveal + focus behavior. Hannah — update the figma with badge contrast + icon variations and write a short a11y checklist. Ravi — sketch URL format and a short migration doc. I'll book a 20m sync tomorrow to finalize handoff. Thanks! :sparkles:
